Read `/AGENTS.md` and `/skills/elasticsearch-learning/SKILL.md` before editing course content.

For Step 8 and later, one lesson must map to one `summaries/step-NN.md` file and, when Elasticsearch commands are involved, one `kibana/step-NN.kibana` file. Do not append new lessons to `kibana/steps-01-07.kibana`.
